name: Browser Ops
description: Local browser automation primitives for admin workflows, form filling, calendar-link management, downloads, and appointment booking with approval gates.

commands.name: /browser
commands.description: Internal/debug browser automation command surface; natural-language requests should normally use the browser-automation skill.

requiredConfig.name: SABLE_BROWSER_STATE_DIR
requiredConfig.description: Private root for browser profile, downloads, artifacts, and active task state.

requiredConfig.name: SABLE_PRIMARY_BOOKING_LINK
requiredConfig.description: Primary public calendar booking link for calendar-link workflows.

privateDataPolicy: Do not store browser cookies, downloaded files, screenshots, form contents, credentials, card details, or appointment details in the plugin manifest.
